ImageDescription.value:
The Atari 2600, a video game console released by Atari in 1977. Originally called the Atari Video Computer System, the system was the most popular gaming console of the late '70s and early '80s. This model is the "Light Sixer", which is the second 2600 model that featured six front switches, and heavy metal RF shielding with angled edges.
(The "Heavy Sixer", which was the first 2600 model with six front switches, had thick plastic & metal RF shielding with round edges instead.)
